name: avnu
description:
avnu is a decentralized trading and liquidity protocol built on Starknet, designed to deliver reliable execution and a smooth user experience.

Our mission is to build the Liquidity Infrastructure that powers trading and integrations across Starknet. We focus on removing friction by abstracting complexity, optimizing routing, and making everyday actions like swapping, DCA, and interacting with liquidity simpler for both users and dApps. We believe the best way to serve the ecosystem is to combine competitive pricing, broad asset access, and a product experience that feels natural to use.
short_description: Best execution on Starknet. No fluff.
